newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Orion 1996 profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Orion 1996 profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 739 million markka median forecast for Finnish pharmaceuticals producer Orion-Yhtyma Oy's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecast by 15 analysts, EPS by 13 analysts).
Orion's results are due on February 21 at 0830/0630 GMT.
In 1995, Orion had a 670 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, 11 of the 15 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 806 million markka (mean 809 million) in a 776-868 million markka range.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie, Den Danske Bank, Erik Selin, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock, Paribas and Postipankki.
